sources.note: Main company page. Describes CHN Tech Solutions as healthcare enterprise, lists products: Integrated Care EHR, Elevations, RPM, Resource Manager, Data Warehouse. Cloud-based, AWS-hosted, FQHC-focused.

Primary ICE product page. Detailed feature list: specialty modules (primary care, pediatrics, women's health, psychiatry, therapy, MAT), screening tools, FQHC billing, lab/radiology interfaces, e-prescribing, patient engagement, UDS reporting, chronic care management.
Elevations product page. Community care coordination platform for closed-loop referrals, social care funding, whole-person care. Separate from core EHR.
SDOH Platform page. Primarily training videos (3 parts) and pricing PDF link. Minimal feature detail.
Secondary ICE page. Minimal content — mostly ONC certification statement and links to mandatory disclosures.
Real World Testing page. Links to 2024 and 2025 RWT plans and 2024 RWT report PDFs. No substantive product details.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists downloadable PDFs: ONC certificate, product info and costs, MFA documentation, clinical standards compliance. Content in PDFs not directly readable.
ONC technical documentation landing page. Links to FHIR API, REST API, Standard API references, CCD operations, EHI export, MFA docs, and mandatory disclosures.

ICE login portal hosted at MyCHN domain. Confirms product runs on OpenEMR (references OEMR registration). Notes VeraDigm e-prescribing discontinued May 2024, transitioned to NewCrop/SureScripts. English/Spanish language options. Nightly maintenance 11:30PM-1:00AM.

MyCHN (Community Health Network) — nonprofit FQHC in greater Houston area. 19 locations across Brazoria, Galveston, and Harris County. Services: primary care, pediatrics, women's health/OBGYN, behavioral health, dental, pharmacy.
Open Health News tag page for ICEHR. Minimal content — mostly links to Tolven-related articles. No substantive information about ICE specifically.

OpenEMR features wiki page. Confirms base platform capabilities: scheduling, billing (ANSI X12 to clearinghouses), patient portal, e-prescribing via third-party integration, clinical decision rules, demographics, reports.
Software Advice FQHC/CHC software comparison. Integrated Care EHR / CHN Tech Solutions not listed among reviewed products. No third-party reviews found.
